address: Van Beuningenstraat 48, Amsterdam-West (Staatsliedenbuurt): 1978 social-housing block of tan brick with grey concrete bands, balcony runs and rounded corners, in four storeys on the south-east and three on the north-west
notes: Van Beuningenstraat 48 (BAG pand 0363100012093853, built 1978, 140 3DBAG wall surfaces, roof max 18.9 m): a 1978 social-housing block in the Staatsliedenbuurt, an S-shaped plan of tan brick with pale grey concrete bands between the floors, deep balcony runs and rounded corner ends; a Huis van de Buurt community centre occupies the south-west corner (its sign is visible on w06-225). Eight walls were fetched; the south-east front (w02-135, 2017-03-07), the north-west front (w01-315, 2025-06-18) and the north-east end (w03-45, 2025-06-18) are drawn.

walls[0] = panel 41 (SE, 54.6 m, eaves 15.9): four storeys of paired windows with grey string courses and recessed balcony bays; drawn as 4 storeys x 13 bays with string courses and solid-rail balconies in every fourth bay on storeys 1-3. walls[1] = panel 9 (NW, 54.6 m, eaves 11.6): three storeys, 13 bays, string courses, balconies every fourth bay on storeys 1-2. walls[2] = panel 28 (NE, 40 m, eaves 11.7): three storeys, 9 bays, string courses.

Simplified: the photographed balcony runs are continuous recessed loggias in alternating bays, drawn as slab balconies in every fourth bay; the 3DBAG plan keeps the rounded corners as short straight facets; the grey bands are the kit string courses; the south-west and cylindrical end walls (w06-225, w08-315), the courtyard faces (panels 118, 70, 20) and the stair-tower walls are not drawn and stay blank brick.
